Aspertia [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]] }} '''Mr. Perfect''' (Japanese: '''VSゲノセクトI''' ''VS Genesect I''), titled '''VS Genesect I''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 526th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the second chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Genesect I''' (Japanese: '''ミスター・パーフェクト''' ''Mister Perfect'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Mr. Perfect''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Cheren}} and {{adv|Bianca}} discuss the earlier [[Pokédex]] distribution. * [[Drayden]] calls Cheren to inform him about {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}}, the third Pokémon born at the same time as {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}} and {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}. * Drayden reveals that [[Iris]] has been made [[Gym Leader]], although he plans on returning to his former position later. * {{adv|Blake}} and {{adv|Looker}} head to the [[Aspertia City]] alleyways. * Blake meets with the {{adv|Magician}} to get specialized [[Poké Ball]]s. * A [[Blake's Genesect|flying saucer]] begins attacking the city. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * {{adv|Magician}} ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Kyurem}} * {{p|Genesect}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} (fantasy) * {{adv|Looker}} * {{adv|Cheren}} * {{adv|Bianca}} * [[Drayden]] (video) * [[Alder]] (fantasy) * [[Bianca's father]] * {{adv|Magician}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Reshiram}} ({{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram|Black}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}) * {{p|Lampent}} ({{adv|Bianca}}'s) * {{p|Zekrom}} ({{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom|N}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Corphish}} ({{adv|Magician}}'s) * {{p|Kyurem}} ({{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Genesect}} (later {{OP|Blake|Genesect}}) * {{p|Grimer}} * {{p|Trubbish}} * {{p|Scolipede}} {{-}} {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS525 |prevtitle=The Transfer Student |nextcode=PS527 |nexttitle=Flying Type |series=Black 2 & White 2 |colorscheme=Unova2}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[de:VS.
